item.title: Chicago man arrested for trying to meet minor in Bloomington
item.description: A 26-year-old Chicago man was ordered held in jail pending the outcome of allegations he traveled to Bloomington to meet what he believed was a 13-year-old girl for sex, and faces multiple felony charges including indecent solicitation of a child, solicitation to meet a child, grooming and traveling to meet a minor.

item.title: Bradley University expands opportunities for women athletes
item.description: Bradley University is adding women's hockey, flag football, STUNT, soccer, and wrestling to its club offerings, starting in the 2026-2027 school year, with the support of the Nick and Nancy Owens Excellence Fund.

item.title: Mary Lincoln's dress on display at Abraham Lincoln Presidential Libary and Museum
item.description: The Abraham Lincoln Presidential Library and Museum is displaying the "strawberry dress" worn by former First Lady Mary Lincoln, which is rarely put on public display due to its fragility.

item.title: Firearms and ammunition seized during Goodfield search warrant
item.description: Kyle Peterson was arrested after officers executed a search warrant in Goodfield and recovered three shotguns, two rifles, and two pistols along with various ammunition.

item.title: Dee-Mack set for first appearance at girls state basketball tournament
item.description: The Deer Creek-Mackinaw girls basketball team will make its first-ever appearance at state Thursday, playing Rockford Christian in the Class 1A state semifinals at CEFCU Arena.

item.title: IHSA Girls Basketball Finals to tip off in Bloomington-Normal
item.description: VisitBN and the Illinois High School Association are hosting the Girls Basketball State Finals at CEFCU Arena in Normal from March 5-7, with an estimated 15,400 attendees and $1.59 million in economic impact for the Bloomington-Normal area.

item.title: Peoria County sees drop in felony and juvenile cases in 2025
item.description: The Peoria County State's Attorney's Office annual report showed a decrease in felony, weapons, and juvenile vehicle theft cases in 2025, with 981 felony cases, 375 domestic violence cases, 354 juvenile delinquency cases, and 1,341 misdemeanor cases.

item.title: Propane tank explosion devastates vacant home in Canton
item.description: A propane tank explosion caused a fire to a vacant home in Canton, believed to have been ignited by squatters using the tank as a makeshift heat source.

item.title: Mayor Rita Ali opposes Pritzker's housing plan
item.description: Mayor Rita Ali criticized Governor JB Pritzker's plan to make a statewide mandate of zoning requirements in Illinois municipalities, arguing that zoning decisions should be made locally.

item.title: Growing risk of severe weather Friday night
item.description: Peoria, Ill. (WMBD) -- A strong storm system will bring the area our first widespread risk of severe weather on Friday. The Storm Prediction Center has placed all of central Illinois within a Level 2 Risk (Slight Risk) for severe storms.
